# AISH consumption and accounting
Load when: consumption receipts, accounting, reconcile or import
Applies to: lpm-ai-cost    Source: lpm `src/server/aishConsumptionStore.ts`, `src/server/aishAccountingStore.ts`, `src/lib/aishUsageReports.ts`, `src/cli/lpm.ts` (`handleAishConsumptionOutbox`, `handleAishUsageReport`); cards `list_aish_consumption`, `adjust_aish_consumption`, `get_aish_accounting`, `reconcile_aish_accounting`, `import_aish_accounting`, `get_aish_usage_report`

## Summary
The consumption ledger is append-only: runners write observations, the owner may append adjustments; nothing is rewritten.
`get_aish_accounting` computes one activity's projection and its `sourceFingerprint` without writing.
`reconcile_aish_accounting` [C] saves that projection as the current snapshot, only for the fingerprint you showed.
`import_aish_accounting` [O] brings historical facts: preview, owner approval, apply, then reconcile.
Pages are never totals: use the totals the tools return, or say the total is not available.

## Facts
| Field / value | Meaning | Consequence for the agent |
|---|---|---|
| consumption entry `kind` | `observation` (runner receipt) or `adjustment` (owner correction, a signed delta of `originalEntryId`) | never adjust an adjustment; never add page quantities as a job total |
| entry order | by entry id (a hash), not by time | loop `cursor` = `nextCursor` until null to see everything |
| `totalsScope: "not-computed"` | `list_aish_consumption` returns no totals | budget totals come from `get_aish_budget` |
| adjustment rules | 1–8 deltas, each a metric present in the original; result per metric ≥ 0; token counts integer | money deltas move budget and pool counters and can trip the circuit breaker (pause) |
| runner outbox | CLI `lpm aish consumption record --file <receipt.json>` queues a receipt; `lpm aish consumption flush --json` sends the queue | flush exits 1 while receipts are pending; receipts belong to the runner operator (`lpm-aish-runners`) |
| `projection.sourceFingerprint` | 64-hex hash of every accounting source of the activity | the only valid `expectedFingerprint` for reconcile |
| `projection.complete`, `gaps`, `conflicts` | whether every bucket is backed by data | `complete == false` → report the gaps; never fill them with zero |
| measured vs estimated | separate measures; attempt sums and interval union are not additive parts; rework is a subset | report each measure apart; never add the projection to legacy `actualHours` |
| `stale` | the saved snapshot differs from the live sources | `true` → offer reconcile (row 6) |
| reconcile result | `currentSnapshotId`; the same fingerprint always gives the same id | safe to retry; it never changes budgets, reservations or `actualHours` |
| "Accounting sources changed" | the data moved after your read | read again, show the new projection, ask again |
| bounds | at most 1000 records per source; snapshot at most 800 KB | "exceeds the bounded snapshot" → not computable over MCP; say so |
| import `mode` | `preview` writes nothing and returns `expectedFingerprint`; `apply` needs it | always preview first and show the projection to the owner |
| import payload | `importId`, `origin{namespace, workspaceId, watermark, evidenceSha256}`, up to 200 facts, every fact mapped as distinct or mirror, reason 8–1000 chars, at most 600 KB | an unmapped fact fails even the preview |
| applied import | permanent; returns `reconciliationRequired: true` (= "reconcile now", not the budget/pool STOP); never charges a budget | then `get_aish_accounting` → `reconcile_aish_accounting` (SKILL.md row 6) |
| runner time report | `get_aish_usage_report`: machine time in ms per runner account, groups by `workspace`, `project`, `runner` or `job` | hours = `durationMs` / 3,600,000; runner time is never human labor |
| report paging | `totals` and `groups` already cover every filtered row; `snapshotHash` must stay the same across pages | never sum pages; a changed hash → restart without `cursor` |
| report range | `[from, to)`, default the last 30 days, at most 366 days | split longer ranges |
| time quality | exact, lease-derived, heartbeat-estimated, unattributed | state the quality counts with the hours |
| CLI | `lpm aish usage report --account <accountId> --json` (`--limit` on the CLI, `limitCount` on MCP) | the runner account id comes from the user or `lpm aish accounts list` |

## Rules
1. Show the projection (buckets, gaps, fingerprint) before asking for the reconcile "yes".
2. Reconcile only with the fingerprint from the read you showed; a new read needs a new "yes".
3. Corrections need the owner's evidence SHA-256 and reason; never correct a receipt to match a guess. `adjustmentId` = "adj-" + `entryId`[0:16] + "-" + `evidenceSha256`[0:16], so a retry never applies the delta twice.
4. State unknown values as unknown; never turn a gap or a missing bucket into zero.

## Examples
```text
example: "reconcile a contabilidade da atividade ABC-12"
get_aish_accounting(projectId, issueId) -> projection.complete true, stale true,
  projection.sourceFingerprint "3f9c…e1"
show buckets + "Reconcile with fingerprint 3f9c…e1? (yes/no)" -> "yes"
reconcile_aish_accounting(projectId, issueId, expectedFingerprint="3f9c…e1")
get_aish_accounting(projectId, issueId) -> stale false, currentSnapshotId = the returned id
```
